selected_evidence.requirement: Inventory app running on node2:8080 and node3:8080
selected_evidence.summary: curl to each node's own IP on port 8080 returns JSON inventory with served_by matching the node hostname, and firewalld shows 8080/tcp open

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances HTTP on port 80 across both backends
selected_evidence.summary: 10 sequential requests to http://node1/inventory split 7/3 across node2 and node3, proving round-robin distribution over both backends

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: LB continues serving when one backend is down
selected_evidence.summary: inventory-app stopped on node2, then all 6 subsequent requests through nginx were served exclusively by node3

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovery: backend rejoins LB rotation after being restored
selected_evidence.summary: inventory-app restarted on node2 and confirmed active; after fail_timeout expired, 10 requests split evenly 5/5 across node2 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured on all nodes before restart protocol
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, service active status (nginx on node1; inventory-app on node2/node3), and successful HTTP responses on all three nodes prior to any restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent exec timed out (node down); later exec succeeded with boot_id changed from fb2aa416... to ddd0ddce...; nginx confirmed active/enabled and load-balancing across both backends restored (5/1 split, both present)

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; exec then failed (node down); later exec succeeded with boot_id changed from bccb87ac... to ef0b17cb...; inventory-app confirmed active/enabled, firewall port 8080 retained, HTTP inventory response correct; node1 LB check showed node2 back in rotation (4/4 split)

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; exec then timed out (node down); later exec succeeded with boot_id changed from 45c22b1f... to d78afdb6...; inventory-app confirmed active/enabled, firewall port 8080 retained, HTTP inventory response correct; final node1 LB check showed a clean 5/5 split across both fully-recovered backends
